text:
Maya (People Ops): Announcing a Paid Volunteer Time policy and $150 annual Community Stipend. Effective 2026-10-01. Policy + claim steps: https://redwood.atlassian.org/people-ops/benefits/volunteer-stipend-2026 

Benefits-Bot: Summary: Up to 2 paid days/year for volunteer work (manager sign-off required) + $150/year reimbursable stipend for donations/classes/volunteer-related costs. Receipts needed for stipend > $25.

Jordan Park: Nice! Can I split the two days across events?

Maya (People Ops): Yes, split or use both days at once. Manager approval required; log hours in the time-off form as "Volunteer Day".

Samira Khan: Is the stipend eligible for political donations?

Maya (People Ops): No. Stipend excludes political contributions. Eligible items listed in doc (training, supplies, local charity donations).

Jordan Park: Do managers get visibility into where people volunteer? Any privacy concerns?

Maya (People Ops): Managers see the day request and a short description (organization name + event). You can request confidentiality for sensitive activities; People Ops will redact details on request.

People-ops-Support: To claim: submit "Volunteer Day" request, then file a stipend expense with receipt and short note. Stipend reimbursed within 10 business days.

Samira Khan: Any restrictions for managers approving during busy sprints?

Maya (People Ops): Managers should balance staffing needs and encourage volunteering. If a conflict, suggest an alternate date within 90 days. Critical business needs may require rescheduling.

Jordan Park: Will this carry over if unused?

Maya (People Ops): Volunteer days do not carry over; stipend does not roll beyond the calendar year (use-it-or-lose-it).

Benefits-Bot: Reminder: see FAQ in the policy doc for examples and vendor list. Office hours next Tue 10:00 PT in #people-ops-office-hours for Q&A.

Samira Khan: Thank you! Love this.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks team ":heart:" — ping people-ops@redwood.com with questions.
